_about: Single source of the event PA announcements and how often they play. scripts/build_pa_announcements.py renders ONE file per clip — chime, then every language in `order`, over one continuous music bed — into docs/pa/audio/, verifies each language by transcription, and stamps this file's sha256 into the audio manifest; docs/pa/ shows a red banner when the two disagree. Edit wording, voices or timing HERE only, then run the build.

rotation._about: auto clips play round-robin. With music loaded: one announcement after every `every_songs` songs. Without music: one every `every_minutes_without_music` minutes.

_order: Lauren 13.10.2026: every announcement in English AND Spanish — English first, then Spanish.
_voices: voice = a Kokoro voice name or a blend {name: weight}. pitch_semitones > 0 = younger/brighter (rubberband, formants preserved). Lauren 13.10.2026 asked for cuter, younger girls' voices: sample D (EN) and F (ES). 13.10 later: Lauren — the English voice 'sounds like she's going to sleep'. Measured on deal_75 (librosa pyin): the bella+nicole blend had 2.04 st intonation and 8.6 s; af_nicole alone 1.97 st (whispery). af_jessica: 3.79 st, 6.1 s, 211 Hz → chosen. Measure before choosing a voice.

bed._about: Original music bed under each announcement (scripts/pa_bed.py, composed in code — ours). Level is relative to the voice.

_say: How the voice must pronounce a written phrase, per language. The text keeps the real spelling (for display and the transcription check); only the audio uses this.
_must_hear: Phrases that must come back word for word when a clip is transcribed, in every clip whose text contains them. The overall match ratio cannot catch a broken brand name inside a long sentence (13.10.2026: 'tema Queub Blowout Sale' scored 0.88 and passed); this can.
_when: A clip may carry `when`: {days: [mon..sun], from: 'HH:MM', until: 'HH:MM'} — all optional, event-local time (the speaker phone's clock at the venue). Outside it the clip is skipped by the rotation; its manual button still plays it. Mirror it in the Soundtrack campaign (domains/events-social.md).

clips.en: Hey beauties, welcome to The Makeup Blowout Sale! Grab a bag, take your time, and enjoy shopping your favorite brands at up to seventy-five percent off.
clips.es: ¡Hola, bellezas! Bienvenidas a The Makeup Blowout Sale. Tomen una bolsa, tómense su tiempo y disfruten sus marcas favoritas con hasta setenta y cinco por ciento de descuento.

clips.en: Hot deal alert! Everything here is up to seventy-five percent off. When it's gone, it's gone, so if you love it, grab it now!
clips.es: ¡Alerta de ofertas! Todo aquí tiene hasta setenta y cinco por ciento de descuento. Cuando se acaba, se acaba. ¡Si te encanta, llévatelo ahora!

clips.en: Don't miss our twenty-two piece brush set, just five dollars. That's ninety-five percent off! Ask any of our team where to find it.
clips.es: No te pierdas nuestro set de veintidós brochas, a solo cinco dólares. ¡Eso es noventa y cinco por ciento de descuento! Pregunta a nuestro equipo dónde encontrarlo.
clips._when: Lauren 13.10.2026: the $5 brush-set deal is announced ONLY on Friday morning, until 12:00 (event-local time).

clips.en: Want a free lipgloss? Find our post on Instagram at The Makeup Blowout Sale, share it with your friends or on your story, and show it to our cashier. Your free lipgloss is waiting!
clips.es: ¿Quieres un lipgloss gratis? Busca nuestra publicación en Instagram, The Makeup Blowout Sale, compártela con tus amigas o en tu historia y muéstrasela a nuestra cajera. ¡Tu lipgloss gratis te espera!

clips.en: Did you sign up for our text list? Show your text message at checkout and get a free eyeshadow with your purchase!
clips.es: ¿Te registraste en nuestra lista de mensajes? Muestra tu mensaje de texto en la caja y recibe una sombra de ojos gratis con tu compra.

clips.en: Have you seen our famous Mystery Box? It's packed with up to fifteen beauty surprises, worth over one hundred twenty dollars, for just forty-five dollars! That's even less than online. Grab yours before they're gone!
clips.es: ¿Ya viste nuestra famosa Mystery Box? Trae hasta quince sorpresas de belleza, con un valor de más de ciento veinte dólares, ¡por solo cuarenta y cinco dólares! Es aún más barata que en línea. ¡Llévate la tuya antes de que se acaben!
clips._facts: Lauren 13.10.2026: $45 at the event ($49.95 online). Contents from the online store page (box.themakeupblowout.com, read 10.10.2026): up to 15 products, worth $120+.

clips.en: Looking for the best deals? Find our Best Sellers barcode and scan it with your phone camera. You'll see today's top offers right away! Scan it, shop it, love it!
clips.es: ¿Buscas las mejores ofertas? Busca nuestro código de Best Sellers y escanéalo con la cámara de tu teléfono. ¡Verás al instante las mejores ofertas de hoy! ¡Escanea, compra y disfruta!
clips._facts: Lauren 16.10.2026, her text: 'Looking for the best deals? Scan our BEST SELLERS barcode and grab today's top offers!' — reworded for the speaker, meaning kept.

clips.en: We're here all weekend! Text your sister, your bestie, your mom. Tell them The Makeup Blowout Sale is in town, but only for a few days.
clips.es: ¡Estamos aquí todo el fin de semana! Escríbele a tu hermana, a tu mejor amiga, a tu mamá. Diles que The Makeup Blowout Sale está en la ciudad, pero solo por unos días.

clips.en: Show us what you got today! Tag us on Instagram at The Makeup Blowout Sale, with hashtag Makeup Blowout Sale.
clips.es: ¡Muéstranos tus compras! Etiquétanos en Instagram, The Makeup Blowout Sale, con el hashtag Makeup Blowout Sale.

clips.en: Today is our last day in town! This is your final chance to stock up at up to seventy-five percent off.
clips.es: ¡Hoy es nuestro último día en la ciudad! Es tu última oportunidad de llevarte todo con hasta setenta y cinco por ciento de descuento.

clips.en: Attention shoppers, we close in thirty minutes. Please bring your final picks to the register. Thank you for shopping with us!
clips.es: Atención, cerramos en treinta minutos. Por favor lleven sus últimas compras a la caja. ¡Gracias por comprar con nosotros!

clips.en: Attention shoppers, our event is coming to an end. Please bring your final picks to the register and complete your purchase. Thank you so much for shopping with The Makeup Blowout Sale!
clips.es: Atención, nuestro evento está por terminar. Por favor lleven sus últimas compras a la caja y completen su compra. ¡Muchas gracias por comprar en The Makeup Blowout Sale!
